name: Salesforce
shortInfo: A single, shared view of every customer
brief: Salesforce is a customer relationship management solution that brings companies and customers together. It’s one integrated CRM platform that gives all your departments — including marketing, sales, commerce, and service — a single, shared view of every customer.
about:
Salesforce unites your marketing, sales, commerce, service, and IT teams from anywhere with Customer 360 — one integrated CRM platform that powers our entire suite of connected apps. With Customer 360, you can focus your employees on what’s important right now: stabilising your business, reopening, and getting back to delivering exceptional customer experiences.  
  
Learn more about [Salesforce API documentation.](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/integration-apis)
